About the Author

Writing from the inside of the storm.

Matthew Paul Culwell Sr. is an enrolled Chickasaw citizen, author, and founder based in Ada, Oklahoma. His dystopian fiction does not speculate about the future from a distance. It is written by someone living at the intersection of technology, sovereignty, and survival in real time.

With two books published and a third on the way, his Dystopia trilogy explores what remains when systems fail, what communities protect when institutions cannot, and what it costs to remain human in a world optimized for everything else.

When he is not writing, he is building Sovereign Shield Technologies, a sovereign GPU cloud company for tribal and rural communities, and Sovereign Creations, a suite of AI tools built for authors like you.
